items.title: সবজির দামে কিছুটা স্বস্তি, কমেছে খাদ্য মূল্যস্ফীতি
items.description: বাংলাদেশ ব্যাংকের ‘বাংলাদেশের মূল্যস্ফীতির ধরন: জুলাই–সেপ্টেম্বর ২০২৬’ শীর্ষক প্রতিবেদনে দেখা যায়, চলতি অর্থবছরের প্রথম প্রান্তিকের গড় খাদ্য মূল্যস্ফীতি ৭ দশমিক ১৩ শতাংশে নেমেছে। আগের প্রান্তিকে এই হার ছিল ৮ দশমিক ৬৮ শতাংশ।

items.title: How to build a balanced investment portfolio
items.description: Many people in Bangladesh earn a decent income and invest their savings yet often fail to generate satisfactory returns. In some cases, they even lose their principal by making poor investment decisions.

items.title: Economic zones built to end land, gas woes are stuck with both
items.description: Around a decade ago, the authorities began issuing licences for private economic zones to speed up industrialisation, attract domestic and foreign investment, create jobs and expand exports.

items.title: Bangladesh must brace for another inflationary shock
items.description: Bangladesh needs to prepare for another bout of inflation as global prices could rise from this coming winter, driven by surging oil prices and higher agricultural production costs, economists warned yesterday.

items.title: Bank Asia to set up Hong Kong subsidiary
items.description: Bank Asia’s board has approved a plan to set up a wholly owned subsidiary in Hong Kong, with an initial capital injection of HK$6 million over three years.

items.title: Imported items’ contribution to inflation rises: BB
items.description: The contribution of imported goods to inflation is increasing, reflecting Bangladesh’s growing exposure to international price pressures despite a moderation in overall consumer prices, according to Bangladesh Bank (BB).

items.title: Dollar nears Tk 124 in inter-bank market
items.description: The US dollar rose to nearly Tk 124 in the inter-bank market yesterday as banks faced mounting pressure to settle payments for oil and gas imports through letters of credit (LCs).
